build_identity_predictor: build an IdentityPredictor that returns input sequences as predictions for testing generation tasks
create_dummy_generation_task: create a DummyGenerationTask subclass that computes element-wise subtraction metrics between predictions and inputs
register_task_with_config: register a new generation task using the register_task decorator with a custom config class
run_task_with_predictor: run a registered task with a predictor, data loading config, and dataset config to get TaskResult
test_dynamic_predictor_loading: test building a predictor dynamically from the PredictorRegistry using get_config_cls and build_predictor
